content: The University of the Philippines College of Medicine is the medical school of the University of the Philippines, Manila, which is one of the constituent universities of the University of the Philippines System. It is recognized as the premier medical school in the Philippines. The University of the Philippines Health Sciences Center was established in 1967 by law to provide training and research in various health sciences disciplines. In 1979, it became an autonomous member of the University of the Philippines System. Subsequently, in 1982, it was renamed the University of the Philippines Manila. By 1983, UP Manila was reorganized to align with the structure of other autonomous universities within the UP System. The UP College of Medicine is one of seven resident degree-granting units of the University of the Philippines Manila. The college has been designated as a Center of Excellence in medical education by the Commission on Higher Education. It has consistently produced top-performing graduates in the national licensure examinations for Filipino physicians. The college frequently competes with other prestigious institutions, such as the University of Santo Tomas Faculty of Medicine and Surgery and De La Salle Health Sciences Campus, in producing top scorers in the medical licensure exams. Despite this competition, the UP College of Medicine maintains one of the highest passing rates among all medical schools in the country. The college offers a variety of academic degree programs. At the undergraduate level, it provides a Bachelor of Science in Basic Medical Sciences. Its professional program includes the Doctor of Medicine degree. Graduate programs offered by the college include the following: Master in Orthopedics Master in Clinical Audiology Master of Science in Basic Medical Sciences Master of Science in Biochemistry Master of Science in Epidemiology (Clinical Epidemiology) Master of Science in Clinical Medicine with majors in: Child Health Family and Community Health Medical Oncology Obstetrics and Gynecology Surgery Master of Science in Pharmacology Master in Physiology Doctor of Philosophy in Biochemistry The college also conducts post-graduate courses, medical conferences, and training workshops for medical professionals and health workers. The college benefits from its affiliation with the Philippine General Hospital, the largest public hospital in the Philippines, which serves as its primary teaching and training facility.
